audience: Legal, sales and operations teams that draft and track contracts in Oneflow

useCases.title: Find contracts and check their state
useCases.text: List contracts by state, workspace, folder, template, tag or a search text. Open one contract for its name, state and timestamps.

useCases.title: Review parties and signing status
useCases.text: List the parties of a contract with their participants. Open one participant to see the signing state.

useCases.title: Read data fields and files
useCases.text: List the data fields of a contract with their current values, such as dates and prices. List its files as metadata only.

useCases.title: Look up workspaces, templates and folders
useCases.text: List the workspaces, templates, folders and tags. Workspace and template ids are needed to create a contract.

useCases.title: Create a draft contract from a template
useCases.text: Create a draft contract from a template in a workspace. The draft is not published, so nobody receives a link to sign.

useCases.title: Update data fields or add a comment
useCases.text: Set the values of data fields on a contract. Or add a comment, optionally as a reply to another comment.
